name: Mutator
description:
Drive Mutator from your own systems. Keys come with any paid plan, and what a key reaches depends on the plan.

**Nothing here publishes.** No endpoint schedules a post, so no key of any scope can cause anything to reach a social account: a post exists only once a person has put a particular file in a particular account's schedule, in Mutator.

Lists are paged by cursor (`after`, `nextCursor`), and `post.published` and the other webhook events are delivered signed. See the full documentation at /docs/api.
